set.body:
Problem: build.sbt:189-190 pins Intaglio 596b398, 247 commits behind Intaglio main edcdfd5. The pin lacks NamedPicking, JavaFxInteractionHost/View, JavaFxOverlayStyle, ClassedColorScale, withRowHeights, SvgFonts, layout-unit hatch (51b32de) and the bounded raster cache (5531d22). PLS Neuro obtains newer Intaglio only through -Dscalafim.intaglio.build, a migration exception.
Repin hazard: SurfaceSceneCodec (threshold encoding, ~:184-190) matches DisplayThreshold on Disabled and TransparentBand only. Intaglio cdf1562 added Below, Above and TwoSided (Display.scala:84-86). surface-view is outside the -Werror module set, so the repin compiles with a warning and throws MatchError at runtime when such a threshold is encoded.

Acceptance:
- Pin a full Intaglio SHA at or after edcdfd5 (coordinate with bd-01M249KVV594XXRVFC0670RMAT history).
- SurfaceSceneCodec encodes and decodes all DisplayThreshold cases; JVM+JS round-trip test for each.
- Compile is warning-clean for the affected modules; design graphics and surface-view suites pass on JVM and JS.
- Record direct-consumer impact (PLS Neuro) in the verification note.

Out of scope: adopting new Intaglio features in ScalaFIM views.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Repin Intaglio to current main and encode every DisplayThreshold case
